headline: State aid is coming for citizens; NBS reveals whether it will push up prices: Banks get easier cash disbursement, here's how
summary: The National Bank of Serbia said announced one-off state aid for pensioners and adult citizens will not have significant inflationary effects. The payments are already in its new inflation projection, and it has cut banks' cash-securing costs.
why: The National Bank of Serbia is the country's central bank, setting monetary policy and its inflation outlook. Fiscal transfers can affect inflation and the dinar's stability.
